properties.description: disrotatory (thermally symmetry-forbidden) channel. No distinct saddle resolved: the ts_0003 attempt collapsed onto the same stationary point as the ZZ-inward saddle (E=-234.391682 Ha, -631.6 cm-1). No barrier declared. Untried test: constrained/relaxed scan driving the two methyl torsions in opposite senses while stretching C2-C5.
properties.attempt_record: Disrotatory saddle search attempts (all recorded, none successful): ts_0003/jobs/declaration_0003 ts_opt/refine.log + frequency/frequency.log converged to E = -234.391681966 Ha with one imaginary frequency -631.576 cm-1, which is the conrotatory-ZZ-inward saddle, not a disrotatory one; ts_0003 declaration_0005 refine.log ended at E = -234.391671622 Ha with normal_termination=false; declaration_0004 was an input defect (Gaussian L202, d(H10-C1) = 0.46 A). These are attempt outcomes, NOT proof that no disrotatory saddle exists.
properties.status: no verified saddle; channel investigated, unresolved

properties.barrier_definition: dE# = E(TS_EE) - E(RC), electronic only; reproducible from native saddle+freq logs
properties.irc_connectivity: Bidirectional IRC from the same verified saddle (ts/ts_0001/jobs/declaration_0007/irc/irc.log: normal termination, both directions converged, fwd=61 / bwd=29, final E = -234.459190892 Ha). Reactant-side outer frame: intact cyclobutene, C2-C5 = 1.58 A, methyl torsions 119.5/119.5 deg = RC. Product-side outer frame: diene, C2-C5 = 3.10 A, methyl torsions 178.3/178.3 deg (E,E), central torsion -27.5 deg. Both outer frames were optimised unconstrained to zero-imaginary minima: reactant -234.459198284 Ha, product -234.477891634 Ha -> genuine (2E,4E).
properties.product_conformer_note: The IRC landed on a CONFORMER of the product: the relaxed endpoint (-234.477891634 Ha, central diene torsion -27.5 deg, s-cis-like) is 3.4 kcal/mol above the quoted s-trans species minimum qm/P_EE_optfreq.log (-234.483262073 Ha, 180 deg). Same (2E,4E) stereoisomer, not interchangeable; the barrier uses the RC reference.

Separate Opt-only and Freq-only endpoint logs are not sufficient for that check.

properties.note: Symmetry-forbidden 4pi thermal disrotatory channel (Woodward-Hoffmann). No distinct saddle was obtained: the saddle searches collapsed onto the conrotatory-ZZ-inward saddle (see TS_EZ attempt record). No barrier is declared; the channel is retained only as investigated-unresolved.
properties.constrained_scan: Decisive test performed. (a) verify/disrot/disrot_scan4.log (job 1348, Opt=ModRedundant, B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP): relaxed scan of C2-C5 from 1.58 to 2.42 A in 0.06 A steps with both methyl torsions FROZEN in opposite senses (D(1,2,3,4) held at 178.0 deg outward, D(3,4,5,6) held at 90.0 deg inward - verified in the Optimized Parameters table). Energy profile: +49.40 (1.58), +48.26 (1.64, minimum), then rising to a maximum of +60.53 kcal/mol at d(C2-C5) = 2.18 A, then falling to +44.65 at 2.42 A (relative to RC = -234.459195859 Ha). This constrained-path maximum is an UPPER BOUND, not a barrier: the methyl torsions were held fixed, so it is not a stationary point of the full PES and no barrier is declared for this channel. It lies ~29 kcal/mol above the conrotatory-EE saddle (31.30) and ~18 kcal/mol above conrotatory-ZZ-inward (42.37), so the disrotatory path is strongly disfavoured, consistent with it being a thermally forbidden 4pi process. (b) Earlier attempt verify/disrot/disrot_scan2.log: the 'D i j k l value F' form was echoed by Gaussian with a 'B' flag and did not hold (methyls relaxed to ~124 deg), so that run is a plain C2-C5-constrained path with a maximum of +29.89 kcal/mol at 2.18 A and does NOT discriminate the channels. (c) verify/disrot/disrot_scan3.gjf failed at L202 (H10-H15 0.32 A) because the rigidly rotated start geometry contained a clash; fixed by choosing the 90 deg inward target (clash-free).

remaining_gaps.summary: The thermally forbidden disrotatory channel to (2E,4Z)-hexa-2,4-diene was investigated but no distinct saddle was obtained, so no barrier is declared. Three saddle searches failed: ts_0003/declaration_0003 collapsed exactly onto the conrotatory-ZZ-inward saddle (E = -234.391681966 Ha, one imaginary frequency -631.576 cm-1), ts_0003/declaration_0005 ended with normal_termination=false at E = -234.391671622 Ha, and declaration_0004 was an input defect (Gaussian L202).
remaining_gaps.constrained_scan: verify/disrot/disrot_scan4.log (job 1348, B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, Opt=ModRedundant): C2-C5 scanned 1.58 -> 2.42 A in 0.06 A steps with both methyl torsions frozen in opposite senses (D(1,2,3,4) = 178.0 deg outward, D(3,4,5,6) = 90.0 deg inward). Constrained-path maximum +60.53 kcal/mol at d(C2-C5) = 2.18 A (vs RC = -234.459195859 Ha). This is an UPPER BOUND on a constrained path, not a saddle barrier; it lies ~29 kcal/mol above conrotatory-EE (31.30) and ~18 kcal/mol above conrotatory-ZZ-inward (42.37).
remaining_gaps.non_discriminating_scan: verify/disrot/disrot_scan2.log reached +29.89 kcal/mol at 2.18 A, but the 'D i j k l value F' input form was echoed by Gaussian with a 'B' flag and the dihedral freeze did not hold (methyls relaxed to ~124 deg), so that path does not represent the disrotatory coordinate.
remaining_gaps.what_would_close_it: A genuine Opt=(TS,CalcFC,NoEigentest)+Freq search started from the constrained-peak frame (or from a properly constructed disrotatory guess) followed by a bidirectional IRC; if it converges to a first-order saddle its dE would be declared on e_EZ.
remaining_gaps.impact_on_delivery: None for the two delivered channels: both conrotatory edges are saddle-, frequency-, bidirectional-IRC- and endpoint-minimum-verified and Supervisor-accepted, with barriers 31.30 (EE, favoured) and 42.37 (ZZ-inward) kcal/mol and a +11.07 kcal/mol difference.
